full_name: Petrus Liu | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Petrus Liu is an associate professor of Chinese and comparative literature and of women’s, gender, and sexuality studies at Boston University, where he teaches transnational queer theory, Marxist cultural criticism, and the literatures and digital media of Cold War cultures. He is the author of Stateless Subjects: Chinese Martial Arts Literature and Postcolonial History (Cornell University Press, 2012) and Queer Marxism in Two Chinas (Duke University Press, 2015), winner of the Alan Bray Memorial Book Award Honorable Mention and a studies category finalist for the 2015 Lambda Literary Award.
